purpose: The counts stated in section 1 of docs/plugins/annotation-store-divergences.md for the AlphaMissense plugin under transcript_match=1: both engines run over the GRCh38 chromosome 21 ClinVar records, and the am_class and am_pathogenicity fields of every row compared.

plugin.source: https://github.com/Ensembl/VEP_plugins, branch release/116, commit 229bb6489d6ac20552f3a3f68134b586ed5fe3c4, the copy the image ships under /plugins

ensembl_cache.vep_rs_cache: the JSON conversion of the same cache by scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl (docs/cache-conversion.md), its chromosome 21 transcript shards

fasta.source: https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-116/fasta/homo_sapiens/dna/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa.gz, decompressed and indexed; the reference docs/divergences/reproducing.md names

commands.ensembl_vep: vep -i clinvar_grch38_chr21.vcf -o ensembl_vep.txt --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache root> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --fasta Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa --buffer_size 5000 --fork 16 --no_stats --force_overwrite --dir_plugins /plugins --plugin AlphaMissense,file=alphamissense.tsv.gz,transcript_match=1
commands.vep_rs: vep -i clinvar_grch38_chr21.vcf -o vep_rs.txt --offline --json_cache <json cache>/homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38 --fasta Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --fork 16 --buffer_size 5000 --force --no_stats --plugin AlphaMissense,file=alphamissense.tsv.gz,transcript_match=1
commands.comparison: rows keyed on (Uploaded_variation, Location, Allele, Feature); the am_class and am_pathogenicity entries of the Extra column compared per row; for every row vep-rs alone fills, the prediction file queried at the row's position and the version digits of the transcript matching the row's Feature tallied

notes: The 20 records with no alternate allele (ALT `.`) write no row on either engine.
Every row vep-rs alone fills is a prediction whose transcript version has two digits, the shape AlphaMissense.pm line 259 strips one digit of; no prediction on a one-digit version differs.
